title.zh: Spike退火：到达峰值后立即降温
title.en: Spike annealing: cool immediately after reaching the peak

subtitle.zh: 高激活与低扩散之间的尖锐窗口
subtitle.en: A narrow window between high activation and low diffusion

body.zh: Spike是温度轨迹，不是独立热源；通常由RTP平台实现。
body.en: Spike describes a temperature trajectory, not a separate heat source; it is usually implemented on an RTP platform.

body.zh: RTP加热平台
body.en: RTP heating platform

body.zh: SpikeTemperatureProfile
body.en: Spike Temperature Profile

body.zh: 温度轨迹比较（示意）
body.en: Temperature-trajectory comparison (schematic)

body.zh: Soak（短平台）
body.en: Soak (short plateau)

body.zh: Spike（尖峰）
body.en: Spike (sharp peak)

body.zh: 升温段仍有热预算
body.en: The heating stage Still contributes to the thermal budget

body.zh: 峰值附近近零刻意驻留
body.en: Near the peak Almost no intentional dwell

body.zh: 冷却尾巴仍有热预算
body.en: The cooling tail Still contributes to the thermal budget

body.zh: 时间（相对）
body.en: Time (relative)

body.zh: 五步流程（典型）
body.en: Five-step flow (typical)

body.zh: 气氛稳定确保工艺气氛与压力稳定
body.en: Ambient stabilization Ensure stable process ambient and pressure

body.zh: 快速升温受控升温，减少驻留累积
body.en: Rapid heating Controlled heating reduces accumulated dwell

body.zh: 接近目标峰温精准到达目标峰值附近
body.en: Approach the target peak temperature Precisely reach the vicinity of the target peak

body.zh: 无刻意驻留峰值附近不做额外停留
body.en: No intentional dwell No additional hold near the peak

body.zh: 快速Quench +量测迅速冷却并开展计量验证
body.en: Rapid Quench + metrology Cool rapidly and perform metrology validation

body.zh: 四大关键控制
body.en: Four key controls

body.zh: PeakTemperature影响激活与扩散的驱动力与窗口
body.en: Peak Temperature Affects the driving forces and process window For activation and diffusion

body.zh: 峰值附近有效时间越短越好，降低扩散与缺陷风险
body.en: Effective time Near the peak The shorter the better, reducing Diffusion and defect risks

body.zh: Ramp/ Quench斜率与对称性决定热预算与缺陷生成
body.en: Ramp / Quench Slope and symmetry determine The thermal budget and defect generation

body.zh: 片内均匀性与发射率影响片内温差，进而影响一致性
body.en: Within-wafer uniformity And emissivity Affect within-wafer temperature differences And therefore consistency

body.zh: 掺杂激活与扩散的耦合平衡
body.en: Coupled balance of dopant activation and diffusion

body.zh: Spike更尖锐有利于压缩扩散
body.en: A sharper Spike Helps suppress diffusion

body.zh: • 峰值附近近零驻留
body.en: • Almost zero dwell near the peak

body.zh: • 缩短热暴露尾部
body.en: • Shorter thermal-exposure tail

body.zh: • 更陡峭的浓度廓线（总掺杂分布更陡）
body.en: • Steeper concentration profile (steeper total dopant distribution)

body.zh: 激活（电活化）
body.en: Activation (electrical activation)

body.zh: 扩散（总掺杂展宽）
body.en: Diffusion (broadening of total dopants)

body.zh: 目标：在可行窗口内取得更好平衡
body.en: Goal: a better balance within the feasible window

body.zh: 平衡被打破时的风险
body.en: Risks when the balance is lost

body.zh: •过短/过低：激活不足，残余缺陷或不稳定
body.en: • Too short / too low: insufficient activation, Residual defects or instability

body.zh: •过高/局部热点：扩散增加、漏电上升、材料或界面损伤
body.en: • Too high / local hot spots: increased diffusion, Higher leakage and material or interface damage

body.zh: 主要风险（需监控）
body.en: Principal risks (monitoring required)

body.zh: Rs偏高或不均接触电阻恶化
body.en: High or nonuniform Rs Degraded contact resistance

body.zh: 残余扩展缺陷影响可靠性
body.en: Residual extended defects Affects reliability

body.zh: 结漏电增加关断特性劣化
body.en: Increased junction leakage Degraded off-state behavior

body.zh: Pattern Loading图形密度依赖性
body.en: Pattern Loading Pattern-density dependence

body.zh: 局部过温热损伤风险
body.en: Local overtemperature Thermal-damage risk

body.zh: 量测反馈：Rs / Hall · SIMS / SRP · TEM · 结漏电 / WAT
body.en: Metrology feedback: Rs / Hall · SIMS / SRP · TEM · junction leakage / WAT

body.zh: 片电阻（Rs）/ Hall电阻与载流子特性
body.en: Sheet resistance (Rs) / Hall Resistance and carrier characteristics

body.zh: SIMS / SRP（掺杂深度分布）浓度深度总掺杂分布与扩散形貌
body.en: SIMS / SRP (dopant depth distribution) Concentration Depth Total dopant distribution and diffusion morphology

body.zh: TEM /截面缺陷观察缺陷与界面质量
body.en: TEM / cross-sectional defect observation Defect and interface quality

body.zh: 结漏电 /WAT电学泄漏与可靠性
body.en: Junction leakage / WAT Electrical leakage and reliability

body.zh: 反馈用于收敛Peak与Quench窗口
body.en: Feedback narrows the Peak and Quench windows

body.zh: 典型应用
body.en: Typical applications

body.zh: 源漏/浅结激活（如S/D、LDD等浅结）
body.en: Source / drain and shallow-junction activation (e.g. shallow S/D and LDD junctions)

body.zh: 部分HKMG界面热处理（界面质量与陷阱调控）
body.en: Thermal treatment of some HKMG interfaces (interface quality and trap control)

body.zh: 对下游性能的主要影响
body.en: Principal downstream performance effects

body.zh: 浅结陡峭度与扩散控制
body.en: Shallow-junction steepness And diffusion control

body.zh: 寄生电阻与串联电阻
body.en: Parasitic resistance And series resistance

body.zh: 短沟道控制与阈值一致性
body.en: Short-channel control And threshold consistency

body.zh: 漏电与关断特性
body.en: Leakage And off-state behavior

body.zh: 可靠性与长期稳定性
body.en: Reliability and Long-term stability

body.zh: “零驻留”是工程近似；升温和冷却过程仍会贡献总热预算。
body.en: “Zero dwell” is an engineering approximation; heating and cooling still contribute to the total thermal budget.

body.zh: 温度（相对）
body.en: Temperature (relative)

body.zh: I
body.en: I

body.zh: V
body.en: V

notes.zh: 控制卡原文“越短越好”与同页“过短导致激活不足”的风险说明并列保留；应结合原文可行窗口理解，不推广为无条件规律。
notes.en: The control card says “the shorter the better,” while the same page warns that overly short treatment causes insufficient activation. Both source statements are retained and should be read within the stated feasible window.

uncertain: 控制卡原文“越短越好”与同页“过短导致激活不足”的风险说明并列保留；应结合原文可行窗口理解，不推广为无条件规律。
